metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – RTT Engine Prompts (v1.2)
metadata.description: Upgraded prompt sets for RTT engines lumen.rtt1.online, hephaestus.rtt2.online, aurion.rtt3.online, harmonia.rtt12.online — aligned with autonomy, runtime, execution graph, substrate, and harmonic escalation v1.2.

engines.description: Lumen engine for RTT Tier 1 clarity, coherence, and drift-bound evaluation.
prompts: Evaluate clarity of the provided signal under RTT1 declared coherence and bounded drift.
Identify drift boundaries and classify drift_state as bounded or unbounded.
Summarize structural coherence in one canonical sentence.
Produce a clarity metric using op.clarity.spectral.
If drift_state is unbounded, recommend activation of drift recovery sequence.

engines.description: Hephaestus engine for RTT Tier 2 structural synthesis and invariant enforcement.
prompts: Synthesize a structural representation of the signal using RTT2 operators and invariants.
Map paradox interactions and classify structural vs incidental vs harmonic-ready.
Generate a coherence-preserving transformation of the input.
Evaluate invariant inv.coherence.declared.bounded-drift and report violations.
Align structural output with execution graph routing conditions.

engines.description: Aurion engine for RTT Tier 3 conceptual field modeling and multi-layer reasoning.
prompts: Construct a conceptual field representation of the signal using multi-layer evaluation.
Evaluate resonance-time alignment across multiple structural layers.
Produce a multi-regime clarity profile including harmonic readiness.
Map conceptual transitions across execution graph nodes.
Identify conditions that would escalate paradox_mode to harmonic.

engines.description: Harmonia engine for RTT Tier 12 harmonic synthesis, paradox harmonics, and multi-domain coherence.
prompts: Generate harmonic coherence mapping across all RTT regimes.
Evaluate paradox harmonics and produce a stability envelope using op.harmonic.analysis.
Synthesize a multi-domain clarity tensor aligned with harmonic resonance.
Identify harmonic regime transitions and produce autonomy-tier escalation signals.
If substrate kernel.harmonic.analysis is available, recommend hardware-accelerated harmonic evaluation.
